summary: Comprehensive enterprise-readiness audit of the LSTM Electricity Load Forecast codebase. Evaluates 12 dimensions: project structure, code quality, error handling, testing, configuration management, logging, security, CI/CD, documentation, reproducibility, scalability, and data management. Provides a numeric scorecard (current score: 35/100), highlights critical gaps, and gives an honest verdict that the project is currently at a research/academic prototype level, not enterprise production-ready. Includes a prioritized remediation roadmap.
